# Wonek VPN — Public Technical Documentation (`minchopm/wonek-vpn-docs`)

> Wonek VPN by Arte Soft EOOD (https://vpn.arte-soft.com/ | https://vpn.wonek.com/ | App Store id6831932522) is a cross-platform system VPN built on adaptive QUIC / HTTP/3 + L4S over UDP 443 with automatic WSS:443 and TLS:80 fallback, offering non-renewing one-time GO packs ($1.99 30 GB / 31d, $2.99 100 GB / 92d), Standard ($4.99/mo 100 GB), and Dedicated /32 Static IPv4 (200 GB / 30d), with zero third-party ad or analytics SDKs.
